  const home=document.getElementById('v3520VersionHome');if(home)home.textContent='V35.64';
  const chip=document.getElementById('v30VersionTag');if(chip)chip.textContent='V35.64 · SPRITES MYSTERY DUNGEON';
  document.title='Pokémon Torre V35.64 — Clima e status PMD';
 }
 render=function(){const r=prevRender.apply(this,arguments);label();return r;};
 renderBattle=function(){const r=prevBattle.apply(this,arguments);label();return r;};
 window.PokemonTorreVersion='V35.64';
 window.PokemonTorreV3564Diagnostics=()=>({version:'V35.64',protected:window.PokemonTorreGolpesProtegidos?.total||25,weather:window.PokemonTorreV3564WeatherDiagnostics?.(),status:window.PokemonTorreV3564StatusDiagnostics?.(),shiny:window.PokemonTorreV3559Diagnostics?.()});

/* Melhora generica dos projeteis do adversario, sem substituir efeitos de golpes aprovados. */
(function(){
 'use strict';
 const prev=BattleEngine.prototype.drawProjectile;
 let drawings=0;
 function path(c,ps,color,w,a){if(ps.length<2)return;c.save();c.globalAlpha=a;c.strokeStyle=color;c.lineWidth=w;c.lineCap='round';c.lineJoin='round';c.beginPath();ps.forEach((p,i)=>i?c.lineTo(p.x,p.y):c.moveTo(p.x,p.y));c.stroke();c.restore();}
 BattleEngine.prototype.drawProjectile=function(p){
   if(!p||p.from!=='enemy'||!this.ctx)return prev.call(this,p);
   const c=this.ctx,col=(TYPE_COLOR[p.type]||'#d4eaf0');
   const vx=p.vx||0,vy=p.vy||0,r=Math.max(4,Math.min(15,p.r||6));
   const points=(p.tail||[]).map(a=>({x:a.x,y:a.y}));
   if(points.length<2){points.unshift({x:p.x-vx*.016,y:p.y-vy*.016});points.push({x:p.x,y:p.y});}
   // Particulas leves com movimento em vez de uma imagem plana ou um quadrado.
   path(c,points,col,r*.52,.40);
   path(c,points,'rgba(255,255,255,.75)',1.4,.60);
   c.save();c.translate(p.x,p.y);
   c.rotate(Math.atan2(vy,vx));
   const phase=performance.now()*.016+p.x*.01;
   if(p.type==='rock'||p.type==='ground'){
     c.fillStyle='#bca68d';c.beginPath();c.moveTo(-r*.8,-r*.2);c.lineTo(-r*.22,-r);c.lineTo(r*.8,-r*.4);c.lineTo(r*.64,r*.77);c.lineTo(-r*.56,r*.88);c.closePath();c.fill();c.strokeStyle='#625041';c.lineWidth=1.4;c.stroke();
   }else if(p.type==='electric'){
     c.strokeStyle='#fff5b0';c.lineWidth=2.6;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(-r,-r*.55);c.lineTo(0,-r*.5);c.lineTo(-r*.1,r*.15);c.lineTo(r*.65,-r*.20);c.lineTo(r*.14,r*.85);c.stroke();
   }else if(p.type==='fire'){
     c.fillStyle='#ff994a';c.beginPath();c.moveTo(-r*.9,r*.33);c.quadraticCurveTo(-r*.2,-r*1.6,r*.85,-r*.24);c.quadraticCurveTo(r*1.1,r*.6,r*.15,r*.9);c.closePath();c.fill();c.fillStyle='#ffe28d';c.beginPath();c.ellipse(0,r*.25,r*.35,r*.55,0,0,Math.PI*2);c.fill();
   }else if(p.type==='water'){
     c.fillStyle='#73d2ff';c.beginPath();c.moveTo(-r*.8,0);c.quadraticCurveTo(0,-r*1.5,r*.85,0);c.quadraticCurveTo(0,r*.95,-r*.8,0);c.fill();c.strokeStyle='#e9ffff';c.lineWidth=1.3;c.stroke();
   }else if(p.type==='grass'){
     c.fillStyle='#8ee86c';c.beginPath();c.ellipse(0,0,r*1.25,r*.52,Math.sin(phase)*.2,0,Math.PI*2);c.fill();c.strokeStyle='#e8ffb0';c.lineWidth=1.1;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(-r,0);c.lineTo(r,0);c.stroke();
   }else if(p.type==='poison'){
     c.fillStyle='#9a63c6';c.beginPath();c.arc(0,0,r*.82,0,Math.PI*2);c.fill();c.strokeStyle='#e3b7ff';c.lineWidth=1.2;c.stroke();
     for(let i=0;i<3;i++){const a=phase+i*2.1;c.beginPath();c.arc(Math.cos(a)*r*.58,Math.sin(a)*r*.52,r*.24,0,Math.PI*2);c.stroke();}
   }else if(p.type==='psychic'||p.type==='ghost'){
     c.strokeStyle=p.type==='ghost'?'#b4a2ff':'#fac1ff';c.lineWidth=2;
     c.beginPath();c.ellipse(0,0,r*1.06,r*.63,phase*.3,0,Math.PI*2);c.stroke();
     c.beginPath();c.arc(0,0,r*.28,0,Math.PI*2);c.fillStyle='#fff0ff';c.fill();
   }else{
     c.strokeStyle=col;c.lineWidth=2;c.beginPath();c.arc(0,0,r*.80,0,Math.PI*2);c.stroke();
     c.fillStyle='#f7f7e8';c.beginPath();c.arc(0,0,r*.30,0,Math.PI*2);c.fill();
   }
   c.restore();drawings++;
 };
 window.PokemonTorreV3565EnemyFX={diagnostics:()=>({drawings})};
})();

/* Unico selo de versao, sem chips duplicados. */
(function(){
 const V='V35.66', prevRender=render,prevBattle=renderBattle;
 function update(){
  document.title='Pokémon Torre '+V+' · Sprites anteriores restaurados';
  const heading=document.querySelector('.brand strong');if(heading)heading.textContent='POKÉMON TORRE · '+V;
  const home=document.getElementById('v3520VersionHome');if(home)home.textContent=V;
  const tag=document.getElementById('v30VersionTag');if(tag)tag.textContent=V+' · SPRITES ANTERIORES RESTAURADOS';
 }
 render=function(){const ret=prevRender.apply(this,arguments);update();return ret;};
 renderBattle=function(){const ret=prevBattle.apply(this,arguments);update();return ret;};
 update();window.PokemonTorreVersion=V;
 window.PokemonTorreV3566Diagnostics=()=>({version:V,portraits:'V35.64',battleSprites:'V35.64',enemyFX:window.PokemonTorreV3565EnemyFX?.diagnostics(),locked:window.PokemonTorreGolpesProtegidos?.total});
})();

/* V35.66 — Fotos revertidas e Mewtwo de testes. */
(function(){
 const V='V35.66', oldRender=render, oldBattle=renderBattle;
 function version(){
  document.title='Pokémon Torre '+V+' · Fotos restauradas + Mewtwo teste';
  const h=document.querySelector('.brand strong');if(h)h.textContent='POKÉMON TORRE · '+V;
  const home=document.getElementById('v3520VersionHome');if(home)home.textContent=V;
  const chip=document.getElementById('v30VersionTag');if(chip)chip.textContent=V+' · RETRATOS ANTERIORES + MEWTWO TESTE';
 }
 render=function(){const out=oldRender.apply(this,arguments);version();return out;};
 renderBattle=function(){const out=oldBattle.apply(this,arguments);version();return out;};
 version();window.PokemonTorreVersion=V;
})();
